trajectory.response:
I've gathered what I need. Here's the full comparison.

## First, an important finding about ZogSports

ZogSports has rebranded to **Volo Sports**, and it operates in only six US metros — New York, New Jersey, DC Metro, Los Angeles, San Francisco and San Jose. It has **no presence in Italy**, so it can't be used for Genoa. I therefore switched to the local equivalent, which is **UISP Genova** (Unione Italiana Sport Per Tutti) — the body that runs Genoa's amateur/recreational league system, the closest structural match to ZogSports.

I also checked for **kickball** — it effectively doesn't exist as an organised sport in Italy, so that option is off the table.

## Comparison table

All figures below are from UISP Genova's official 2026/27 participation rules (PDFs). Costs are **per team**; the per-player column is my calculation.

| | **Volley per Tutti (VXT)** | **Amatori Misto** | **Over 18 Femminile** | **Tutti nel Misto** | **Calcio a 6** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Sport** | Indoor volleyball, mixed | Indoor volleyball, mixed | Indoor volleyball, women | Indoor volleyball, mixed | 6-a-side football, men 16+ |
| **Skill division** | **Lowest tier.** Unlimited FIPAV up to *Prima Divisione*; max 2 Serie D; Serie C+ banned | Mid. Unlimited Serie D; max 2 Serie C; Serie B+ banned | Highest. Unlimited Serie C; Serie B+ banned | Unlimited Serie D; max 2 Serie C | **"Agonistico"** (competitive) |
| **Social/non-competitive?** | ✅ Yes — genuinely the beginner tier | ⚠️ Semi-competitive | ❌ No | ✅ Yes — min. 2 women + 1 man on court at all times | ❌ No |
| **Season length** | Oct 2026 → national finals June 2027 (~8 months, 2 phases) | Same, Oct–June | Same, Oct–June | Short spring tournament, 4 groups of 4 teams (~Mar–Jun) | 28 Oct → 2 Apr + finals 13 May (~6 months) |
| **Registration fee** | €200 (€180 if paid by 14 Aug) | €200 (€180 by 14 Aug) | €120 (€100 by 14 Aug) | None listed | Not published |
| **Match fee** | €60 / match / team | €60 / match / team | €60 / match / team | €50 / match / team | Not published |
| **Roster cap** | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | — |
| **Est. cost per player** | **~€105–140 (~$125–165)** | ~€105–140 | ~€95–125 | **~€40–50 (~$45–60)** | Unknown |
| **Fits $100 budget?** | ⚠️ Borderline / slightly over | ❌ No | ❌ No | ✅ **Comfortably** | ❓ Unknown |

Per-player maths for VXT, as an example: €200 ÷ 14 players ≈ €14, plus €60 × ~18 matches ÷ 14 ≈ €77, plus ~€15 UISP membership card ≈ **€106**.

## Recommendation

**Primary: Tutti nel Misto** — it's the only option that clearly satisfies all three of your constraints simultaneously. At roughly €40–50 (~$45–60) per player it sits well inside your $100 budget; its rules *mandate* a mixed line-up of at least two women and one man on court, which is the strongest built-in signal of a genuinely social rather than competitive format; and the short spring tournament structure is far lower-commitment than an eight-month championship.

**Second choice: Volley per Tutti (VXT)** — if you want a proper full season starting this October. On pure skill-matching this is actually the *best* fit: it's the only division that caps players at *Prima Divisione* (Italy's lowest registered tier) and bans Serie C and above, so it's the true beginner division. The catch is purely financial — realistically ~€105–140 per head, which overshoots $100 by 25–65%. It only lands near budget if you join a **full 14-player roster** and get drawn into a smaller group.

I'd rule out Amatori Misto and Over 18 Femminile on skill grounds (both admit Serie C/D players), and Calcio a 6 because UISP explicitly classifies it as *agonistico* — competitive — which directly contradicts your non-competitive requirement.

## Three things to verify before you commit

There are a couple of gaps I couldn't close from published sources, and one structural issue worth flagging:

1. **This is not a ZogSports-style individual sign-up.** UISP championships register *teams* affiliated to an ASD club — there's no free-agent queue that places solo players. You'll need to join an existing team or form one. Contact **pallavolo.genova@uisp.it** to ask about placement.
2. **Match fees are the real cost driver**, and the exact match count isn't fixed until calendars are drawn (it depends on how many teams enter). That's the main source of uncertainty in my estimates.
3. **The 14 August early-bird deadline has already passed** (today is 5 September), so the standard €200 / €120 rates now apply — my figures reflect that. Also note the latest published Tutti nel Misto rules are the 2025 edition; the next edition should be confirmed for spring 2027.

You'll also each need a *certificato di idoneità sportiva agonistica* (competitive-level medical certificate) — required for all divisions, and an extra cost not included above.

As requested, **I have not signed up for or paid for anything** — everything is left ready for your review.
